english.title: In charge of vehicle when unfit to drive - Port of Liverpool
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) was in charge of a mechanically propelled vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE..), on a quay or jetty, namely **(..SPECIFY QUAY OR JETTY..), when unfit to drive through drink or drugs
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaw 26(a)(iv) and 39(a) of the Port of Liverpool General Byelaws 2021.
english.pointstoprove: date and location was in charge of a mechanically propelled vehiclewhilst unfit to drive through drink or drugson a quay or jetty in the Liverpool docks

english.notes: (i) Byelaw 26(a)(iv) contains a defence that circumstances were such that the defendant was not likely to drive whilst so unfit.(ii) See byelaw 26(b) for definition of "unfit to drive".
